Go MCP server guidance. Supported Go 1.13–1.24; clean architecture, DI, repository pattern, embedded JSON, MCP `go-updates` tool. Add releases as `data/releases/go{version}.json`; auto-discovered, no code changes; preserve existing structure. Commands:
`go build -o recent-go-mcp`
`go test ./...`
`go test -v -run TestMCPServer`
`go mod tidy`
`go fmt ./...`
`go vet ./...`
MCP examples:
`echo '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/list"}' | ./recent-go-mcp`
`echo '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "go-updates", "arguments": {"version": "1.24"}}}' | ./recent-go-mcp`
`echo '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "go-updates", "arguments": {"version": "1.22", "package": "slices"}}}' | ./recent-go-mcp`
